# Muhammad Ahsan Ali

> Fractional CTO, technical founder partner, SaaS architect and AI engineering leader with 12+ years of experience. MS Computer Science (NLP). Helps startups and growing companies scale software, engineering teams and AI systems. Based in Karachi, Pakistan; works remotely with teams in the US, Australia and the UAE. Visiting faculty and mentor for computer science students.

## Key facts
- Led cross-functional teams of 10-12 twice with CTO-level responsibility.
- Modernized a legacy e-commerce + CRM platform serving ~1M users for an Australian retailer: ~60% faster load times, ~$6k/month lower server costs.
- Designed and deployed a RAG-based AI customer support assistant for a FinTech startup: 85% of tier-1 queries handled, 92% customer satisfaction.
- Leads development of a US multi-vendor platform with thousands of users, including its AI workflow system.
- Delivered 10+ client products as Technical Lead reporting to the CEO of a software studio.
- Designed and built a trading platform and trading engine from scratch for a UAE client; business automation with n8n and Python.

## Services
- [Fractional CTO](https://muhammadahsanali.vercel.app/services/fractional-cto): technology strategy, architecture, hiring, delivery ownership, due diligence.
- [AI integration & RAG development](https://muhammadahsanali.vercel.app/services/ai-integration): RAG chatbots, LLM features, guardrails, n8n/Python automation.
- [SaaS architecture & scaling](https://muhammadahsanali.vercel.app/services/saas-architecture): multi-tenant and multi-vendor platforms, performance, cost control.
- [Legacy PHP & Laravel modernization](https://muhammadahsanali.vercel.app/services/legacy-modernization): staged upgrades without downtime, faster pages, lower server costs.
- [Technical founder partner](https://muhammadahsanali.vercel.app/services/technical-founder-partner): MVP scoping, stack choice, first developer hires.
- [Academic mentorship](https://muhammadahsanali.vercel.app/mentorship): visiting faculty, workshops, curriculum advisory.
